scope: Material current producer-to-receiver boundaries plus every Flask HTTP route, mapped from the current working tree atop the recorded git commit. DeerFlow 2 is the live Stage-1 subsystem, including the default single shared actor-intelligence Track B; generated deployment copies are not double-counted. Optional, compatibility, and pre-cutover surfaces are labeled. DeerFlow 1.x and unrelated future-architecture proposals are excluded.

status_legend.live-default*: Part of canonical current code under checked-in defaults; for a registered command or route this means exposed under defaults, not invoked during every pipeline. A suffix states the precise stage or condition.
status_legend.live-conditional*: Current code used only when the named mode, platform, or condition applies; a suffix states that condition.
status_legend.config-gated*: Current implementation disabled or inactive under checked-in defaults; a suffix states the gate.
status_legend.manual-compat*: Callable compatibility/debug/operator surface outside the canonical unified UI path; a suffix states any extra condition.
status_legend.ephemeral*: Process/browser state that is not authoritative after restart.
status_legend.pre-cutover*: Checked-in DRF2 scaffold, not current production authority.

flows.transport: ThreadPoolExecutor launching independent bridge subprocesses

Every lane retains an isolated thread/output directory and the shared question/contract

flows.producer: Sealed version-3 evidence_synthesis_manifest.json after all accepted Track-A lanes and the baseline Track-B actor dossier
flows.transport: Fresh manifest-bound DeerFlow 2 child with tools disabled, subagents disabled, dual-track disabled and global-synthesis mode enabled
flows.payload: Accepted evidence-only Track-A packs, a unified citation namespace, and one required actor descriptor binding exact dossier, coverage, baseline-source, search-result-receipt, family-projection and optional exact-input judge bytes. Every Tier-1/2 actor is routed as one bounded all-dimensions block; the cast-wide owner receives all blocks or fails closed
flows.receiver: One tool-free global outline/section/stitch synthesis and report judge/refinement path, a deterministic actor-local visible-claim/citation/family coverage audit, then one structured-extraction owner
flows.persistence: evidence_synthesis_manifest.json version 3, final research_report.md/judge, actor_dossier.md/coverage/optional judge, actor family projection and structured artifacts

flows.producer: The broad baseline evidence lane's isolated Track-B actor/ontology thread
flows.transport: One streamed landscape turn, one always-scheduled streamed cast-wide completion pass, tool-free dossier synthesis, then a default-on bounded judge/gap-research/resynthesis loop on one exact Track-B lane/thread/purpose
flows.payload: A force-ranked exact-enum Tier-1/2 cast across 17 actor-intelligence dimensions. Each admitted claim binds a supporting quote/span to a current Track-B fetch receipt and content hash, keeps source publication time separate from claim-valid time, and records epistemic type, status, horizon, confidence, dependencies, contradictions and qualifiers. Critical gaps require two distinct query-bound producer search-result receipts; unsupported slots remain typed evidence gaps
flows.receiver: Deterministic semantic coverage/behavior-family/identity audit and ten-dimension exact-input dossier judge, then baseline artifact gates and the version-3 global synthesis manifest
flows.persistence: actor_dossier.md, actor_dossier_coverage.json with search-result receipts and family projection, optional actor_dossier_judge.json, actor_intelligence_lineage.json, Track-B checkpoint/progress and current-attempt hashes

flows.transport: Deterministic quote/receipt-bound 17-dimension and five-family audit plus default-on ten-dimension tool-free judge and at most two targeted streamed gap-research/resynthesis rounds; a changed candidate is rejudged against the exact bytes it saw
flows.payload: Exact dossier bytes, current Track-B fetch and search-result ledgers, semantic actor/alias namespace, typed gap attempts, canonical relationship and claim projection hashes, visible family claims and finite judge scores for cast correctness, salience, depth, relationships, history, grounding, contradictions, ontology readiness, forward behavior and cast-wide accountability
flows.receiver: Baseline lane publication gate, current-attempt meta binding and global-synthesis manifest writer
flows.persistence: Exact actor_dossier_coverage.json bytes/hash, search-result receipt hash, behavior-family projection hash and optional exact-input actor_dossier_judge.json; explicit final FAIL, malformed/non-finite/stale scorecard or failed deterministic audit yields no dossier

Activity is neutral/source-bound, shared world is explicit-public only, relationships are public verified/actor-stated only, actor-local rows affect only their owner and scheduled events require public source bindings. Any authorized post-READY mutation triggers a complete rebuild and immediate validation of the seal before PREPARE completion

flows.payload: Exact actor-context packs, report/actors/actor-ID provenance, cast, both platform role/profile manifests, final runtime fields, simulation_config.json and simulation_config_manifest.json. Current-v1 missing/tampered config or any unmatched profile fails before READY; an authorized scenario-overlay or WorldState-seed mutation is admitted only through a complete reseal and immediate revalidation. Scenario-event replay is count-preserving and idempotent

Completed read-only reuse independently validates that state-bound seal, remains byte-identical and is never resealed

flows.transport: New-session Python subprocess
flows.payload: Before every start/resume, exact READY state, context/cast/platform role/profile manifests and simulation-config seal are revalidated. The expected config manifest hash is passed as --config-seal; direct child validates adjacent state/manifest/config, then hashes the exact bytes it loads against the validated config SHA. Missing/tampered artifacts, check/use drift or any v2 downgrade fail closed
flows.receiver: run_parallel_simulation.py
flows.persistence: run_state.json, process identity, simulation.log

flows.transport: OASIS env.step with LLMAction through CAMEL/provider adapter
flows.payload: For each selected actor, Twitter loads the manifest-bound newline-normalized actor-role/v2 user_char. Reddit replaces OASIS synthetic demographics with a deterministic structural wrapper plus the exact sealed role, then appends only sealed public world/calendar blocks; final effective _system_message bytes must match and are attested before model execution. Platform memory/state/tool schema remain dependency-owned runtime context
flows.receiver: That actor's OASIS/CAMEL model receives its source-bound, epistemically local role on every active decision turn; selected actions reach Twitter or Reddit
flows.persistence: reddit_runtime_system_messages.json, platform SQLite databases, action JSONL, checkpoints and telemetry

flows.transport: Platform DB writes and action trace extraction
flows.payload: Posts, comments, likes, follows, searches, interviews and other actions
flows.receiver: Action logger, metrics, decision channel, API readers and runner monitor
flows.persistence: twitter_actions.jsonl, reddit_actions.jsonl and platform SQLite databases

flows.transport: Batched application chat_json
flows.payload: Unique actor roster, round evidence and seed scenarios; model output is only agent_id/scenario/magnitude/confidence, after which commitments and status are constructed deterministically
flows.receiver: Decision parser and shared serial WorldState
flows.persistence: Round decisions and decision-channel telemetry

flows.producer: Deterministically constructed committed decisions; abstained, silent, failed and missing outcomes do not advance state
flows.transport: Serial WorldState.step
flows.payload: Scenario commitments, inertia, entropy/calendar controls and round status
flows.receiver: Projected diagnostic outcome state and next-round period context
flows.persistence: world_state_trajectory.json, decisions.jsonl and world_digest.jsonl

flows.producer: Completed action logs only when the script-level _inband_traj_written flag is false; partial/incomplete existing in-band files are not inspected as a fallback trigger
flows.transport: Parallel roster elicitation followed by serial WorldState evolution
flows.payload: Social-simulation evidence grouped by round and actor
flows.receiver: Same diagnostic world-state contract used by report stage
flows.persistence: Decision artifacts and world-state trajectory

flows.transport: File-based command queue and response polling
flows.payload: command_id, interview/env command, target actor/platform and prompt
flows.receiver: Persistent live simulation subprocess
flows.persistence: ipc_commands, ipc_responses and optional ipc_telemetry.jsonl

flows.transport: Two-second file/process/platform polling
flows.payload: Action offsets, process status and platform terminal events; platform simulation_end events establish success even while the process remains alive for interview commands, and premature process exit is failure
flows.receiver: run_state.json, progress callback and pipeline run stage
flows.persistence: Run progress/status and final terminal reason

flows.transport: Deterministic read/aggregation and atomic JSON write
flows.payload: Action logs, derived agent statistics/timeline/top posts, run_state coverage/error state, LLM health, dynamics/config metadata and optional communities; decision/WorldState artifacts are not read into this aggregate
flows.receiver: Simulation health/reuse checks and simulation status/detail APIs; this file is not passed directly into the ReportAgent constructor
flows.persistence: run_summary.json

flows.transport: In-process ReportAgent construction
flows.payload: Graph ID, simulation ID, original question, situation brief, actors, sources, research report, scenario label, optional base-simulation ID, quantitative/contested/timeline evidence and structural graph priors. No run_summary/result/action payload is copied into the constructor
flows.receiver: ReportAgent constructor, which retrieves graph and selected simulation detail through services using those IDs and loads market/current-price material plus ambient or pinned policy/config through its own managers
flows.persistence: Report metadata/progress initialized under reports/<id>

flows.producer: Report evidence loaders plus the separate pre-prose probability-spine builder
flows.transport: Deterministic report-evidence normalization plus forecast-spine LLM draw(s)
flows.payload: Report prose/tools can receive research, graph and labeled simulation diagnostics. Under default diagnostic_only, the probability spine separately receives research actor forecast inputs, situation brief, base rates/scenarios, markets and horizon/as-of with the simulation signal pack explicitly empty. Historical calibration is not a spine input
flows.receiver: The wider report evidence spine feeds outline/sections; the pre-prose probability spine feeds the structured scenario contract
flows.persistence: Report metadata and forecast-spine side data

flows.transport: Bounded section workers using native tools or ReAct, then critique/revision/repair
flows.payload: Section plans, evidence, graph/search/statistics/interview tools and citation rules
flows.receiver: Ordered report section assembler
flows.persistence: outline/progress, section_NN.md, agent and console logs

flows.transport: Native tool call or textual ReAct action
flows.payload: Graph search/statistics, web/search where allowed, or simulation interview request
flows.receiver: Tool executor; observation returned to next section-model turn
flows.persistence: Agent log/tool trace and resulting section evidence

flows.transport: Filesystem plus HTTP polling
flows.payload: Progress, completed sections and current partial section
flows.receiver: ForecastReport progressive renderer
flows.persistence: Report progress and section files; UI state ephemeral

flows.producer: Pinned pre-prose probability spine plus post-assembly binary/market finalization; final report prose only on the no-spine fallback
flows.transport: Pinned-spine reuse, binary draws, exact/near market matching, conditional divergence enforcement and deterministic reconciliation; post-hoc scenario extraction/critique is fallback-only and premortem is config-gated/default-off
flows.payload: Question, horizon/as-of, pinned scenarios, research evidence/base rates and eligible market candidates. Default diagnostic_only excludes simulation from probability inputs; simulation can enter only under a separately promoted legacy policy
flows.receiver: Forecast schema validator and publication gate
flows.persistence: forecast.json and forecast audit/rationale fields

flows.transport: Deterministic lint, citation stabilization and reference reconciliation
flows.payload: Markdown, forecast, source registry and section metadata
flows.receiver: Final audit and persistence
flows.persistence: Citation map/audit/lint metadata and corrected report

flows.producer: Exact final Markdown and forecast bytes
flows.transport: Read-only deterministic audit and hashing
flows.payload: Final artifacts, policy/contract requirements and referenced assets
flows.receiver: Publication gate
flows.persistence: final audit with artifact fingerprints

flows.transport: Atomic/content-addressed file writes
flows.payload: Full report, metadata, forecast, citations, audit, sections, logs, telemetry and visualizations
flows.receiver: Report APIs, frontend and export/feedback services
flows.persistence: uploads/reports/<report_id>/

flows.transport: Publication-policy evaluation before response
flows.payload: Completion/partial state, safety policy, artifact hashes, structured contracts and final audit
flows.receiver: Frontend, download and optional v1 forecast clients
flows.persistence: No new artifact; body/forecast suppressed when not publishable

flows.producer: Eligible finalized English/Chinese primary under default REPORT_BILINGUAL=true after its audit (even if the primary audit failed), or a later manual request that requires a publishable primary; research-dossier translation is a separate process-local flow
flows.transport: Automatic in-process bounded parallel translation units, or manual API cross-process lease/daemon task; both paths perform language audit/repair
flows.payload: Markdown units, protected citations/data and target language
flows.receiver: Opposite-language audited sidecar; exposure requires both primary and variant publication gates. Language/provider availability can make the automatic attempt inapplicable or failed without replacing the source
flows.persistence: full_report.<lang>.md and translation status/audit sidecars

flows.transport: Deterministic lazy builders and PDF subprocess/toolchain with locks/cache
flows.payload: Sealed report bytes, language and exact dependency hashes
flows.receiver: Markdown/PDF/brief/digest download clients
flows.persistence: Content-addressed PDF/manifests, exec brief and digest files

flows.producer: Forecast finalization before final audit/publication, so a row can represent a later-unpublishable or duplicate raw report
flows.transport: Append-only JSONL write
flows.payload: Report ID, horizon/resolution date, scenarios/probabilities, confidence and unresolved status; current writer does not include objective_signals
flows.receiver: Production ledger readers; no atomic linkage guarantees later publication or resolution
flows.persistence: uploads/pipelines/_forecast_ledger/ledger.jsonl

flows.transport: Report/ledger reads plus read-only market HTTP
flows.payload: Anchored binaries, current prices, market resolution state and manual due dates
flows.receiver: Price history, resolution ledger, needs_manual result/Markdown section and monitor report
flows.persistence: price_track.jsonl, _forecast_ledger/resolutions.jsonl and monitor_report.md

flows.transport: Backtest scoring and atomic JSON write
flows.payload: Known outcome/resolution data for one publishable forecast
flows.receiver: Brier/log-loss result and v1 forecast response
flows.persistence: reports/<id>/resolved.json

flows.producer: Production ledger rows only when they themselves contain resolved outcomes; current manual resolved.json and market resolutions.jsonl paths do not update those rows
flows.transport: Deterministic scoring/summary and optional logit recalibration fitting
flows.payload: Forecast probabilities and known outcomes
flows.receiver: Later ReportAgent historical-calibration/confidence annotation when eligible resolved production rows exist; it does not alter the already-derived pinned probabilities, and the current automatic outcome join is otherwise disconnected
flows.persistence: Calibration summary/ledger state; evaluation rows remain in a separate evaluation ledger

flows.transport: Offline deterministic scoring
flows.payload: Golden outcomes plus forecast file/evaluation ledger
flows.receiver: Evaluation report and isolated evaluation ledger
flows.persistence: _evaluation_ledger; never production calibration

flows.producer: Standalone scheduler daemon/tick or external cron
flows.transport: Schedule-state scan then fresh PipelineOrchestrator.start
flows.payload: Due prompt/options, concurrency/max-run limits and prior pipeline ID
flows.receiver: New canonical pipeline and completion watcher
flows.persistence: uploads/schedules/<id>/schedule.json and run history

flows.transport: Deterministic prior/new artifact comparison and optional webhook
flows.payload: Forecast scenarios/probabilities, actor set and graph communities
flows.receiver: Schedule drift history and external webhook
flows.persistence: schedule.json drift_history

flows.transport: Bounded executor running extra prepare/run/report lanes
flows.payload: Deterministic additional seeds and shared base evidence
flows.receiver: Seed-specific reports and ensemble aggregator
flows.persistence: handoff/ensemble_checkpoint.json and ensemble_forecast.json; primary report bytes remain sealed

flows.transport: ContextVars, process meter and bridge telemetry rollup
flows.payload: Run/stage/provider/model calls, tokens, latency, cost estimates, errors and degradation flags
flows.receiver: Run/stage telemetry snapshots and operator diagnostics
flows.persistence: Pipeline/report/simulation telemetry artifacts

flows.transport: Shell process management and HTTP readiness probes
flows.payload: Frontend/backend start/stop/status command and environment
flows.receiver: Flask/Vite processes and browser
flows.persistence: PID files and frontend/backend logs

flows.producer: Two distinct drf2 targets: a chat-native lead/custom-agent topology and a deterministic six-stage driver
flows.transport: Chat topology uses KG/simulation stdio MCP; driver uses persistent Runs API slash-skill lead runs and KG MCP through skills. Its simulation HTTP client is provisional and has no matching implemented HTTP server adapter
flows.payload: Custom-agent/skill exchanges or manifest-backed six-stage artifact contracts and deterministic gates
flows.receiver: DRF2 chat thread/engine tools or deterministic run directory/manifest
flows.persistence: drf2 state/manifest artifacts; not canonical live pipeline state
